shortDescription: Purge records from the IMS Catalog

options.name: buffer_pool_param_dataset
options.description: Defines the buffer pool parameters data set. This option is required if you are running the utility as a DLI.

options.name: dbrc
options.description: Indicates if the IMS Database Recovery Control facility is enabled.

options.name: delete
options.description: Specifies a DBD or PSB instance or an entire DBD or PSB record to delete from the IMS catalog database. This option must be used with PURGE mode and overrides any retention criteria, hence you can remove any DBD or PSB that would not otherwise be eligible for deletion.

options.name: delete_dbd_by_version
options.description: Delete DBD instances based on the specified name and version. If ANALYSIS mode is specified, it will generate DELETE DBD statements in the SYSUT1 data set along with any other delete statements based off the retention criteria. If PURGE or BOTH mode is specified, it will write the delete statements to the SYSUT1 data set and then execute them.

options.name: dfsdf_member
options.description: The DFSDFxxx member in the IMS.PROCLIB data set where the CATALOG section is defined. For example, dfsdf_member is "CAT" specifies the DFSDFCAT member of the PROCLIB data set.

options.name: ims_id
options.description: The identifier of the IMS system on which the job is to be run. Required if online_batch is true.

options.name: irlm_id
options.description: The IRLM ID if IRLM is enabled. Cannot be specified when online_batch is true.

options.name: managed_acbs
options.description: Specifies whether deleting DBD and PSB instances from the IMS catalog causes the corresponding DBD and PSB instances in the IMS directory to be deleted. If 'analysis_mode' is true, the DBD and PSB instances will not be deleted from the IMS directory.

options.name: mode
options.description: Determines which mode the utility runs in. ANALYSIS mode generates delete statements based on the retention criteria and places them in the SYSUT1 data set. PURGE mode executes delete statements in the SYSUT1 data set. BOTH mode performs ANALYSIS and PURGE mode consecutively.

options.name: online_batch
options.description: Indicates if this utility is to be run in a BMP region.

options.name: primary_log_dataset
options.description: Defines the primary IMS log data set. This option is required if you are running the utility as a DLI.

options.name: proclib
options.description: Defines the IMS.PROCLIB data set that contains the DFSDFxxx member. The DFSDFxxx member defines various attributes of the IMS catalog that are required by the utility.

options.name: reslib
options.description: Points to an authorized library that contains the IMS SVC modules.

options.name: resource_chkp_freq
options.description: Specifies the number of resource instances to be deleted or updated between checkpoints. Can be a 1 to 8 digit numeric value between 1 to 99999999. The default value is 200.

options.name: steplib
options.description: Points to IMS.SDFSRESL, which contains the IMS nucleus and required IMS modules. The steplib parameter can also be specified in the target inventory's environment_vars. The steplib input parameter to the module will take precedence over the value specified in the environment_vars.

options.name: sysut1
options.description: The data set where delete statements are written to. Written either by the purge utility when specifying ANALYSIS or BOTH mode, or by the user when specifying PURGE mode.

options.name: update_retention_criteria
options.description: Use this statement to set the retention criteria for DBD or PSB records in the catalog database. You can submit any number of update statements. You cannot specify this option if PURGE mode is selected. If used with any other mode options, it will update the retention criteria first.
